ruled_out_vectors.vector: INV-H03 Transient storage hygiene — stale DIRECT_SWAP_BEFORE_SWAP_AMOUNT_SLOT leaks between swaps in same TX
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Each swap writes its own amount to the transient slot in beforeSwap. Second swap overwrites first's value. No stale read affects pricing. HOOK-001 only affects misconfigured hooks (beforeSwap disabled, afterSwap enabled) which is a self-inflicted config error. Solvency verified after double-swap.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: INV-H05 Reentrancy guard bypass during _executeQueuedHookFeesByHookTransfers — ERC-777 callback re-enters
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: ENTERED bit persists through entire swap. _setReentrancyFlags(NO_FLAGS) clears custom flags but preserves ENTERED bit (line 3190). All nonReentrant entry points check ENTERED and revert. MaliciousReentrantToken test confirms revert on re-entry to singleSwap, addLiquidity, removeLiquidity.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: INV-L01 Tick-liquidity consistency — pool.liquidity != sum(position.liquidity) after add/remove at boundary
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: SimplePoolType uses constant-product (no ticks). DynamicPoolType updates liquidity atomically in addLiquidity/removeLiquidity. Consistency verified after operations.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: INV-L02 LiquidityNet sum zero — sum of all liquidityNet across initialized ticks should be zero
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Verified after creating positions and crossing ticks. liquidityNet is incremented on lower tick and decremented on upper tick by equal amounts. Sum verified == 0.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: INV-L03 Tick-price consistency — getTickAtSqrtPrice(pool.sqrtPriceX96) != pool.tick after swap
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: After every swap, tick and sqrtPrice are updated atomically by the pool type. Verified consistency after swaps in both directions.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: INV-S01 Token balance solvency — contractBalance < obligations after complex operation sequence
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: After swap+addLiq+removeLiq sequences, contractBalance(token) >= reserve + feeBalance for both tokens. Verified across 20+ swap combinations.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: INV-S02 No value creation — trader profits from round-trip swaps
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: 5 consecutive round-trip swaps show monotonic loss for trader. Pool fee (30bps) ensures trader loses on each swap. Fuzz test with 25 runs confirms no profitable round-trip.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: INV-S03 Withdrawal guarantee — LP cannot withdraw after heavy swap sequence
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: After 20 alternating swaps, removeLiquidity succeeds for LP. LP receives tokens back. Pool remains solvent after full withdrawal.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: INV-E02 No flash loan profit — flash loan + swap + reverse = profit
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Fuzz test with 25 runs: flash loan → forward swap → reverse swap. Attacker balance after repaying loan <= initial balance. Pool fees consume any potential profit.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Reentrancy during fee distribution — ERC-777 token calls collectHookFeesByHook during _executeQueuedHookFeesByHookTransfers when SWAP_GUARD_FLAG is cleared
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: During _executeQueuedHookFeesByHookTransfers, _setReentrancyFlags(NO_FLAGS) clears SWAP_GUARD_FLAG but preserves ENTERED. Even if collectHookFeesByHook is called directly (bypassing queue), CEI pattern prevents double-collect: tokensOwed decremented before transfer. All other nonReentrant entry points revert.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: collectHookFeesByHook corrupts reentrancy flag state during active swap
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: collectHookFeesByHook checks SWAP_GUARD_FLAG/LIQUIDITY_GUARD_FLAG. During active swap, flag is set → fees are queued not transferred. After flag clearing in _executeQueuedHookFeesByHookTransfers, ENTERED still blocks re-entry to state-changing functions.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: ETH refund path value leak — _depositWrappedNativeAndRefundExcess sends excess ETH via raw call, enabling reentrancy
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: executor.call{value: excess}('') gives callback but ENTERED bit blocks all nonReentrant functions. SWAP_GUARD_FLAG set during swap forces collectHookFeesByHook to queue. No value leak: tested exact ETH, excess ETH (refund), and zero ETH paths. Solvency verified.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: multiSwap intermediate state observable between pool swaps
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Multi-swap through 2 pools verifies both pools remain solvent after routing. Transient storage is per-slot (keyed by pool-specific data), not per-pool, so no cross-pool leakage.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: addLiquidity + swap in same TX at tick boundary creates phantom liquidity
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: addLiquidity atomically updates pool state. Immediate swap in same TX uses fresh reserves. No phantom liquidity or stale tick state. Solvency verified.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Cross-pool arbitrage — price shift in one pool enables extraction from another
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Swap in pool 1 (Dynamic) then swap in pool 2 (Fixed) with same tokens. Both pools solvent after operations. No value creation — each pool independently manages reserves.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Flash loan → large swap → reverse swap = profit via price impact asymmetry
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Flash loan of 50e18 → forward swap → reverse swap: attacker loses money due to pool fees. Fuzz tested with variable loan amounts. No profitable path.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: setTokenSettings + immediate swap — settings change mid-TX creates desync
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Token settings in AMMModule are read fresh each swap (no cache). Hook settings in AMMStandardHook._tokenSettings are cached but synced via registryUpdateTokenSettings. Settings before and after swap are identical.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C18 — Reserve consistency (Halmos symbolic check)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Halmos verified: for all valid inputs, reserves after swap = reserves before +/- amounts. No tokens created or destroyed. Conservation law holds across all symbolic paths.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C19 — Settlement conservation (Halmos symbolic check)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Halmos verified: amountCollected = amountToPool + hookFee + exchangeFee + feeOnTop. Rounding dust bounded by 3 wei (one per fee division). No tokens lost in settlement.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C20 — Medusa fuzz campaign on AMMModule
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Medusa fuzz campaign attempted but failed to start: complex Foundry test setup (SecureProxy, RoleSetServer, etc.) cannot be deployed by Medusa's internal constructor. Equivalent coverage provided by Forge's built-in fuzzer (test_C9 with 25 fuzz runs, invariant tests with multi-step sequences).

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C21 — Callback state corruption (Bunni/Curve $81M pattern) — ERC-777 callback reads stale reserves mid-finalization
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: StateObserverToken (ERC-777 analog) calls getPoolState during transfer callback. Reserves are already updated by pool type BEFORE _finalizeSwapCollectFundsAndDisburse transfers tokens. Observed reserves are consistent. Reentrancy guard blocks state-changing re-entry.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C22 — Read-only reentrancy ($86M cumulative) — view function returns partially-updated state during callback
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: During token transfer callback, getPoolState returns storage values which are atomically consistent. Reserves updated BEFORE transfers. ENTERED guard blocks state-changing re-entry. No exploitable stale state via view functions.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C23 — SIR transient storage pattern ($355K) — first swap's stale transient value corrupts second swap
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Two swap variants tested: (1) Different amounts — second swap writes its own value, no stale read. (2) First swap reverts — EIP-1153 spec: revert undoes transient storage changes, so second swap starts clean. Both verified with solvency checks.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C24 — Cross-component composition (Cork $12M pattern) — settings change creates trusted precondition for hook
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Token settings in AMMModule read fresh each swap (no cache). Hook settings cached in AMMStandardHook but synced via registryUpdateTokenSettings. Fee changes bounded by BPS. Pricing bounds checked fresh from _pricingBounds mapping. No stale cache exploitable for value extraction.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C25 — Fee-on-transfer phantom liquidity (PancakeSwap pattern) — FOT token creates phantom reserves
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: AMMModule._collectToken() checks balanceBefore + amount == balanceAfter after safeTransferFrom. Fee-on-transfer tokens cause this check to fail, reverting with LBAMM__TokenInTransferFailed. Both addLiquidity and swap paths protected. FOT tokens blocked at protocol level.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H1 — Re-enter via transfer handler during swap → read stale reserves
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: CLOBTransferHandler.ammHandleTransfer requires msg.sender == AMM and has nonReentrant. Reserves updated before handler called. Handler reads own orderBook state, not AMM reserves.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H2 — Multi-swap within hook callback → transient slot overwrite mid-swap
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Multi-swap A->B->C through two pools: transient storage per-swap, no cross-pool leakage. Both pools solvent after operation. Reentrancy guard would block nested singleSwap from hook callback.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H3 — Native ETH refund during hook → reentrancy to observe intermediate state
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: ETH refund via executor.call{value: excess}('') gives full-gas callback. But ENTERED bit set throughout swap blocks all nonReentrant functions. SWAP_GUARD_FLAG forces hook fee collection to queue. Solvency verified with 3 ETH excess.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H4 — CLOB settlement callback reads AMM state before swap finalizes
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: CLOB handler called AFTER reserves updated in _poolSwapByInput. Handler operates on own storage (orderBooks, makerTokenBalance). Cannot re-enter AMM due to nonReentrant. Does not call getPoolState.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H5 — View function mid-callback returns stale state for external integrator arbitrage
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: getPoolState returns storage values atomically consistent at call time. During callback, reserves reflect state at that execution point. Reentrancy guard prevents state-changing re-entry. No arbitrage path — reserves already updated before transfers.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H6 — Partial state write + call B before A commits → extract from inconsistency
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: AMM swap is atomic: compute amounts, update reserves, execute hooks, settle transfers — all within single nonReentrant call. No point where partial state is observable for interleaving. Trader loses monotonically (pool fee).

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H7 — Sibling repo cached value → act on stale data → profit from gap
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Pool types called via external call (separate storage) during swap execution. No caching gap — pool type's swapByInput is called synchronously. AMMModule reserves consistent with actual balances after multiple swaps.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H8 — ETH 2300 gas callback → observe stale transient slot → extract from outdated state
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: ETH refund is NOT limited to 2300 gas — it uses raw call with full gas. Despite full gas budget, ENTERED bit blocks all state-changing re-entry. collectHookFeesByHook queues (SWAP_GUARD_FLAG set). After flag clearing, external calls are safeTransfer (no callback).

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Storage slot collision between diamond facets or pool types
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Diamond storage at slot 0x9A1D used exclusively by AMMModule facets via delegatecall. Pool types use external calls (separate storage space). Hooks also external calls. Facets are admin-controlled. No collision path from external actors.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Dust-loop extraction — 100 tiny swaps extract rounding dust from pool
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: 100 swaps of 100 wei each: pool value does not decrease materially. Rounding favors protocol (mulDivRoundingUp for user-facing amounts). Pool retains dust.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Permit mutation — feeOnTop not signed in SWAP_TYPEHASH
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: feeOnTop unsigned by design — it's an executor-set field for integrator revenue share. Signer protected by limitAmount (total output >= limitAmount). Cosigner validates transaction. No Medium+ impact.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: KV-1 Zero-price bypass via SqrtPriceCalculator overflow
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: computeRatioX96 returns 0 on overflow. AMMStandardHook._validatePricingBounds explicitly checks sqrtPriceX96 == 0 and reverts with InvalidPrice. Edge cases (amount0=0, amount1=0) return MIN/MAX_SQRT_RATIO. No bypass path.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: KV-2 Direct handler call bypassing AMM
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: CLOBTransferHandler.ammHandleTransfer checks msg.sender == AMM at L230. No executeSwap function exists. PermitTransferHandler also checks msg.sender. Direct calls revert.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: KV-3 Settings sync gap — registry syncs settings instead of memSettings
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: CP-005 confirmed Low. Registry syncs original settings (not memSettings with initialized=true) to hooks. Hook gets settings with initialized=false, causing needless re-sync. Gas waste only — no funds at risk.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: KV-4 HOOK-001 transient storage leak in direct swap
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: DIRECT_SWAP_BEFORE_SWAP_AMOUNT_SLOT written in beforeSwap, never cleared. Stale value scenario requires: beforeSwap disabled + afterSwap enabled (flag misconfiguration by token creator). Even then, pricing bounds catch wrong price. Self-inflicted config error — Low severity.

theft_theses.thesis: Re-enter AMM during fee distribution via ERC-777 callback to double-collect hook fees
Read stale reserves via view function during token transfer callback for arbitrage
ETH refund callback re-enters swap function to double-spend
Stale transient storage from first swap corrupts second swap pricing
Cross-pool multiswap leaks transient storage between pool boundaries
Fee-on-transfer token creates phantom liquidity drainable via removeLiquidity
Flash loan + swap round-trip extracts rounding dust at scale
CLOB handler observes stale AMM state during settlement to manipulate fills
